param_input_item.param_description: difference order: positive integer scalar or []

description.p: If X is a vector of length n, result of diff(X) is a vector of first differencesX(2) - X(1), ..., X(n) - X(n-1).
If X is a matrix, result of diff(X) is a matrix of column differences along the first non-singleton dimension.

diff(X, n) applies diff n times along that dimension. When n is not lower than its length, the result is empty along it (other dimensions are kept). diff(X, n, dim) works along dim, which can be after the last dimension of X (its length is then 1).

For a datetime array, diff returns the elapsed time between consecutive elements as a duration array (a daylight saving time change is taken into account). For a duration array, the result keeps the display format of X.

history_item.history_description: datetime and duration inputs; an order not lower than the length gives an empty result along the dimension; any dimension after the last one.
